column1: # Video memory by card family, for the installer's AI kit.
# ⚠️ WHAT IS SOURCED AND WHAT IS ASSERTED. The PCI ids and the card names in
# the generated list come from hwdata's pci.ids, which is authoritative and
# versioned. This file supplies only the memory, by family, because that is
# the one thing pci.ids does not carry and the installer cannot read.
# Order matters: the first pattern that matches a card's name wins, so the
# more specific line goes first. Patterns are matched case-sensitively
# against the name pci.ids gives, e.g. "AD102 [GeForce RTX 4090]".
# Where a family shipped in more than one size, the SMALLER is listed. The
# installer would rather understate what a machine can run than promise a
# model that will not load. The note says when that is the case.
# Corrections are a pull request. Last reviewed 2026-10-06.
